agent_interface.rule: Task-specific context plus golden paths should constrain agent search before code generation.

construction_order: Understand business requirement and data contract
Choose the closest registered page pattern
Choose semantic layout slots/primitives only where the pattern is insufficient
Reuse registered components, interactions, tables, charts and engineering primitives
Connect service/repository logic to component events
Use registered content/detail/workflow/viewer primitives before creating application-specific presentation components
Apply security/runtime primitives when authentication, uploads, permissions or deployment are involved
Run application tests, startup smoke, and rendered browser checks for visual changes
Only request a framework extension when no registered primitive can satisfy the requirement

escape_hatch.policy: Use only when the registered framework vocabulary cannot satisfy a legitimate requirement.
required_actions: Document why the existing framework is insufficient.
Keep custom code isolated behind an application-specific component or adapter.
Consume NiceGUI Base tokens, accessibility behavior and lifecycle primitives.
Add # nicegui-base: allow-<rule-id> immediately above an intentionally exempt validator line.
Consider promoting broadly reusable behavior into the framework.

hard_prohibitions: Do not invent NiceGUI Base classes, functions, enum values or parameters.
Do not import NiceGUI directly in normal application modules.
Do not create raw AG Grid or ECharts instances in normal application modules.
Do not use arbitrary app-level CSS, pixel spacing, colors, radius, shadows or motion.
Do not download or hotlink UI icons, fonts, images or other visual resources.
Do not use emoji as interface iconography.
Do not manipulate app.storage directly for normal application state.
Do not place database SQL directly in page/view modules.
Do not silently modify NiceGUI Base framework internals or public APIs.
Do not infer causal certainty from commonality or evidence-ranking scores.
Do not create unbounded application caches.
Do not retry non-idempotent mutations automatically.
Do not run blocking CPU or synchronous I/O directly on the NiceGUI async event loop.
Stock NiceGUI/Quasar visual presentation in canonical application UI
ui.notify/ui.menu_item/raw ui.icon in NiceGUI Base integrations
AG Grid without the Company .cui-data-table visual theme
Do not add app-level margins/gaps/radii to repair composition; use Company layout primitives.
Do not use radius values outside control/surface/overlay/pill semantics.
Do not create generic scatter plots for wafer/die spatial engineering views.
Do not constrain the outer .cui-page with app-specific max-width or asymmetric margins; use inner ContentColumn for reading width.
Do not create visible lab/demo actions that have no functional behavior when the action is intended to be testable.
Do not use a generic chart where a Company semiconductor-native renderer exists for the engineering signature.
Do not use raw ui.range or ui.linear_progress in canonical NiceGUI Base application surfaces.
Do not convert inspection/detail/form drawers into centered dialogs; use Company side-sheet primitives.
Do not render textual footer actions in the compact navigation rail.
Do not add a second workflow connector or per-segment rounded seams inside stacked bars.

production_completion.accessibility: Use framework field wrappers and accessible labels; do not remove ARIA relationships or skip navigation.
production_completion.content: Use CONTENT_REGISTRY for metrics, detail presentation, viewers, hierarchy, workflow, comparison, command palette and activity surfaces.
production_completion.durable_jobs: Use DurableJobAdapter for work that must survive process restart; InProcessJobAdapter is not restart-durable.
production_completion.tables: Use rendered NiceGUI Base table toolbar/selection/column/density/server/editing controls; do not bypass with raw AG Grid.
production_completion.visual_resources: Use Icons.* and packaged illustrations; remote UI resources remain prohibited.

purpose: Deterministic construction contract for Gemma/OpenCode applications built on NiceGUI Base.

wave60_analysis_platform.data_rule: Translate table/chart selections into typed shared selections and query filters; keep server-side DataSource pushdown for scalable surfaces.
wave60_analysis_platform.rule: Use one AnalysisContext and SelectionBus per analytical workspace; bind DataSource-backed tables and panels to that shared context instead of page-local filter/callback state.
wave60_analysis_platform.workspace_rule: Use WorkspaceController for move/resize/collapse/hide/lock/dock/split/duplicate/reset/undo state; do not create a parallel layout-state model.

wave61_semiconductor_platform.calculation_rule: Keep SPC/FDC/RCA/yield/DOE calculations rendering-independent and fail explicitly on invalid inputs.
wave61_semiconductor_platform.rule: Use the canonical semiconductor entity model, SemiconductorAnalysisContext over the shared AnalysisContext, DataSource-backed dependent filters, shared populations/SelectionBus, and registered semiconductor surfaces; never create an application-local competing state/filter/population/visualization architecture.
wave61_semiconductor_platform.scale_rule: Preserve DataSource query/pushdown boundaries for fab-scale data; dependency-free reference analytics may be replaced by optimized providers behind adapters.
